business_summary: Jiangsu Changjiang Electronics Technology Co., Ltd., trading as JCET, is an SSE-listed outsourced semiconductor assembly and test provider and the largest such business in China. Its own annual-results release describes it as an integrated-circuit back-end manufacturing and technology provider, which is the same economic role as Amkor and ASE on the advanced-packaging link.

Completion rule applied uniformly across this batch: a profile is COMPLETE when revenue, growth, margins, cash conversion and valuation all resolve to sourced numbers AND the earnings-quality state can be established. A profile whose earnings-quality state cannot be established, or which has no fundamentals at all, is BLOCKED. Individual NULL fields are permitted on a COMPLETE profile where the input is genuinely absent or the computation is not meaningful, and each such NULL blocks O1 promotion on its own.
